entities.summary: Baggy is a British alternative dance genre popular in the late 1980s and early 1990s, and generally associated with the Northern UK's Madchester scene. The style saw alternative rock bands draw influence from psychedelia as well as dance music. baggy is a music genre, created circa 1988. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
